caption:
🇺🇸 More than 100 Israeli settlers rioted overnight in the West Bank village of Jalud, near Nablus, torching homes belonging to the Palestinian Tubasi family and blocking their return after months of forced displacement. Three Israeli Border Police officers were lightly injured responding to the unrest. Israeli President Isaac Herzog condemned the violence as "a moral stain" on the country.

🇪🇸 Más de 100 colonos israelíes protagonizaron disturbios durante la noche en la aldea de Jalud, cerca de Nablus, en Cisjordania, incendiando viviendas de la familia palestina Tubasi e impidiendo su regreso tras meses de desplazamiento forzado. Tres agentes de la Policía de Fronteras israelí resultaron con heridas leves al responder a los disturbios. El presidente israelí, Isaac Herzog, condenó la violencia como "una mancha moral" para el país.

Sources: The Times of Israel, i24NEWS, Al Jazeera — Sept. 29, 2026.
